excluded: new formats, compatibility expansion, fuzz and Windows from postponed point 6

findings_and_fixes: The 0.140 to 0.219 X-Trans failure was reproduced with an ideal unclipped CFA; DR6 interpolation caused the local false colour. DR7 uses independently fitted measured-channel levels or affine surfaces only when every available sample supports them.

HL4 continues independently supported original illumination planes to coherent dark obstacles and small fully clipped tails, with joint completeness for connected clipped colours. It does not recursively seed from inferred samples or neutralize unsupported coloured lights.

Unsupported clipped codes are inequalities, not measured levels. A compact cell map now excludes them from the new demosaic fits. Newly extended components refit existing affine estimates on original 18x18 support to avoid support discontinuity.

The first candidate timed out. Exact separable extrema, monotone queues and mathematically necessary early rejections remove repeated scans. All 1886 diagnostic records and full photographic outputs reproduce the frozen numerical model.

Repeated RAF work exhausted the unchanged XPC 60-second lifetime CPU cap. The broker now reads cumulative CPU on its retained authenticated task and recycles at 10 seconds before the next job. This remains a reserve policy, not a guarantee for long multithreaded jobs or WB.
WB verification now validates refusals on both original and repacked inputs and preserves asymmetric transport errors instead of mislabelling them as an algorithmic acceptance change.

Historical normalized chroma used different near-black populations in 185 regions. Supplemental comparisons use the exact same valid pixel intersection with per-render exclusion counts; RGB and gradient metrics still include the entire region.

HL2_remaining_extrema.scope: Historical per-render normalized chroma and full-region RGB/gradient maxima; distinct from the common-population HL3 comparison. No universal dominance over HL2.

legacy_comparison.scope: Known mathematical scene references; LibRaw is a comparator, not calibrated truth. Group means are descriptive and do not qualify general superiority. Entirely clipped fields without informative contours remain unidentified.

demosaic_regressions.scope: Reused analytical development corpus, not new held-out camera captures; frozen equations preserved by optimization.

real_inputs.scope: Functional and repeatability evidence; no measured colour improvement claimed for these eight captures.

bundle_functional.scope: One functional run, no pressure/RSS assurance. Delivery decoder binaries are identical to the functional-test build.

timing.scope: Decode-only timing includes broker input hash, XPC and transfer, excludes output hash, image analysis and disk reports. Warm OS caches; no whole-machine RSS, cold-start or physical camera accuracy claim. NEF crop geometry differs between native engines. CPU recycling is included; no thermal control or cold-start qualification. This is not an equal-workload kernel comparison.
timing.previous_campaign_scope: Same hashed inputs and full outputs, separate dates/runs; not an interleaved HL3/HL4 benchmark. HL4 is slower in these observations; legacy is interleaved in the final run.

rejected_variants.name: Bayer affine models on axis-aligned steps

verification.initial_debug_GUI_limit: 55-second incomplete run without decode/presentation errors; not counted as passed. Final release bundle tested separately.

remaining_limits: Physical target/illuminant measurements and calibrated camera profiles remain missing.
Some Bayer chroma boundaries, peaks and fully clipped fields still favour the legacy renderer; neutralizing unknown colour would not establish correctness.
A same-RAW/different-scene ambiguity cannot be solved uniquely without additional information.
Physical sensor clipping below the digital ceiling is not characterized.
Photographic X-T5 registration, broad real-camera holdouts, pressure qualification and global R0-R4/SF gates remain open.
The new boundary fitting has a measurable runtime and memory cost; timings, CPU recycling and unequal native crops must be reported explicitly.
Own rendering does not remove codec/data provenance obligations or LibRaw from the retained legacy engine.
